reader.requirement: At COBOL-85, FUNCTION FACTORIAL whose integer argument-1 has the value zero (an integer item, literal 0, figurative ZERO, a signed or binary zero, or an always-integral expression evaluating to zero) must return the integer 1.

edition-consulted.switches: the D8 edition window sig.IntroducedIn > ctx.Edition.DialectLevel / RemovedIn (COBOL1502/COBOL1503); the catalog row carries IntroducedIn 85, so --std 85 admits the function

ConstructRegistry numeric-function-identifier-operand-2002: at 85 a numeric/integer function written where an identifier stands (MOVE, DISPLAY, ADD operand, PERFORM n TIMES) is COBOL0900 per §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4; inside an arithmetic expression it is not consulted

OPTIONS paragraph (2002) and ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD-DECIMAL (2014) are refused at 85, so the renderer's num.StandardDecimal arm is unreachable and only the native arm runs (the same arm 2023 takes without an OPTIONS paragraph)

reader.edition-search: grep for Edition|DialectLevel|CobolVersion|DialectBehavior|ConstructRegistry over IntrinsicRenderer.cs, NumericRenderer.cs, IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs, IntrinsicCarrierRules.cs, FunctionValueLane.cs and src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/Intrinsics/*: no hit; the only edition reads on the path are in IntrinsicBinder (window, placement) and the OPTIONS gates in VersionConformancePass

reader.notes: CobolIntrinsics.Exact.cs#Factorial starts its product at 1 and multiplies from 2, so every zero spelling returns 1; the native arm is the only one reachable at 85 and is the same arm 2023 takes without an OPTIONS paragraph.

refuter.evidence: f7zero.cob at --std 85 (exit 0): FACTORIAL of +0, -0, N-N, INTEGER-PART(-0.5), INTEGER(0.9), MOD(4 2), packed 0, packed 0*-1, SIGN LEADING SEPARATE 0, binary 0, 9PP 0, N*0, N**0-1, FACTORIAL(0)-1, LENGTH(N)-3 each returned 1; 0 - FACTORIAL(0) = -1. f8lit FACTORIAL(0.0) accepted and returned 1 (0.0 always results in integer value 0, §1989:A.2.2 AR4); f9div FACTORIAL(N / 2) refused COBOL1627.
